name: Clarify the meaning of ambiguous or garbled text inputs
description: Users asked the assistant to interpret, define, or clarify the meaning of specific strings, phrases, symbols, or sentences that were ambiguous, garbled, or technically complex. These requests often involved deciphering random character inputs, emojis, or correcting grammatical errors to understand the sender's intended message or context.
